title: Yuanzi-Shichangpu herb pair ameliorates mitochondrial energetics and restores blood-brain barrier integrity in Alzheimer's disease through the HIF-1alpha/GSK3beta-Nrf2/PGC-1alpha axis.
authors: Yao, Qi; Wu, Yaling; Luo, Yuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药药对YZ-SCP通过HIF-1alpha/GSK3beta-Nrf2/PGC-1alpha轴改善AD模型线粒体能量代谢和血脑屏障完整性，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Alzheimer's disease (AD) presents a significant global therapeutic challenge. Growing evidence underscores the critical role of blood-brain barrier (BBB) disruption and cerebral energy metabolism dysfunction in driving AD pathogenesis, often forming a vicious cycle of "mitochondrial impairment-BBB damage-neuronal degeneration." The classic herbal pair of Yuanzhi (YZ) and Shichangpu (SCP) has a long history of use in cognitive disorders within Traditional Chinese Medicine, yet an integrated understanding of how this herb pair systemically modulates key AD pathologies-particularly neurovascular unit integrity and bioenergetic homeostasis remains lacking. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to elucidate the multi-faceted neuroprotective effects of the YZ-SCP herb pair and its underlying molecular mechanisms in AD models. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Both an in vivo D-gal/AlCl(3)-induced AD rat model and an in vitro Abeta-injured bEnd.3 brain microvascular endothelial cell model were employed. Evaluations included cognitive behavior, hippocampal histopathology, BBB integrity, mitochondrial ultrastructure and function, cerebral energy metabolism profiling, and mechanistic analysis focusing on the HIF-1alpha/GSK3beta-Nrf2/PGC-1alpha signaling axis. RESULTS: The YZ-SCP herb pair exhibited enhanced effects in improving spatial learning and memory, ameliorated hippocampal neuronal damage, and restored BBB integrity by upregulating tight junction proteins (ZO-1, Occludin, Claudin-5) and VE-cadherin. Mechanistically, it suppressed the aberrant HIF-1alpha/GSK3beta pathway, activated the PGC-1alpha/Nrf2/SOD2 antioxidant axis, and restored mitochondrial bioenergetics, evidenced by recovered ATP production, membrane potential, and NAD(+)/NADH homeostasis. Energy metabolomics further demonstrated a systemic remodeling of the hippocampal metabolic profile, notably in the TCA cycle. In vitro studies confirmed that YZ-SCP-containing serum dose-dependently improved endothelial mitochondrial function and reduced oxidative damage by modulating the same signaling cascades.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）构成了全球性的重大治疗挑战。越来越多的证据强调血脑屏障（blood-brain barrier, BBB）破坏和脑能量代谢功能障碍在驱动AD发病机制中的关键作用，常形成“线粒体损伤-血脑屏障损害-神经元变性”的恶性循环。远志（Yuanzhi, YZ）和石菖蒲（Shichangpu, SCP）的经典药对在中医中用于认知障碍已有悠久历史，但对该药对如何系统调节AD关键病理——特别是神经血管单元完整性和生物能量稳态——的综合理解仍缺乏。研究目的：本研究旨在阐明YZ-SCP药对在AD模型中的多方面神经保护效应及其潜在分子机制。材料与方法：采用体内D-gal/AlCl(3)诱导的AD大鼠模型和体外Abeta损伤的bEnd.3脑微血管内皮细胞模型。评估内容包括认知行为、海马组织病理学、BBB完整性、线粒体超微结构和功能、脑能量代谢谱分析，以及聚焦于HIF-1alpha/GSK3beta-Nrf2/PGC-1alpha信号轴的机制分析。结果：YZ-SCP药对在改善空间学习和记忆方面表现出增强效应，减轻了海马神经元损伤，并通过上调紧密连接蛋白（ZO-1、Occludin、Claudin-5）和VE-cadherin恢复BBB完整性。机制上，它抑制了异常的HIF-1alpha/GSK3beta通路，激活了PGC-1alpha/Nrf2/SOD2抗氧化轴，并恢复了线粒体生物能量功能，表现为ATP产生、膜电位和NAD(+)/NADH稳态的恢复。能量代谢组学进一步证明了海马代谢谱的系统性重塑，特别是在三羧酸循环（TCA cycle）中。体外研究证实，含YZ-SCP血清剂量依赖性地改善内皮线粒体功能，并通过调节相同信号级联减少氧化损伤。
